label: Classroom Teacher
description: The subject or classroom teacher who teaches the student.
also_known_as: Subject Teacher; Teacher; Home Group Teacher

label: Education Support Staff
description: Staff who provide agreed in-class or personal assistance under teacher and plan direction. Most schools have one name for this — pick or type yours.
also_known_as: Learning Mentor; Inclusion Officer; Teacher's Aide; Integration Aide; Learning Support Officer; Education Support

label: Disability Inclusion Leader
description: Coordinates plans, meetings, evidence and funding processes.
also_known_as: Inclusion Lead; DI Coordinator; Learning Diversity Leader; SENCO

label: Inclusion Leader
description: Whole-school inclusive practice, systems and professional learning.
also_known_as: Learning Diversity Leader; Inclusive Practice Leader

label: Wellbeing Lead
description: Wellbeing coordination, check-ins, re-engagement, safe spaces.
also_known_as: Wellbeing Coordinator; Student Wellbeing Leader; Head of Wellbeing

label: Mental Health Practitioner
description: In-school counselling, psychology or mental health support.
also_known_as: School Counsellor; School Psychologist; Mental Health in Schools Practitioner

label: Principal Class
description: Principal, assistant principal or equivalent leadership.
also_known_as: Principal; Assistant Principal; Head of School

label: Year Level Leader
description: Year level, house or sub-school leadership.
also_known_as: House Leader; Sub-school Leader; Head of Year

label: Literacy Lead
description: Literacy teaching, data and intervention across the school.
also_known_as: Learning Specialist – Literacy; Literacy Coach; English Learning Area Leader

label: Numeracy Lead
description: Numeracy teaching, data and intervention across the school.
also_known_as: Learning Specialist – Numeracy; Numeracy Coach; Mathematics Learning Area Leader

label: Behaviour Lead
description: Behaviour support planning, coaching and incident review.
also_known_as: Positive Behaviour Leader; Engagement Leader; Head of Student Management

label: Personal and Social Capabilities Lead
description: Explicit teaching of self-management and social skills.
also_known_as: PSC Leader; Social and Emotional Learning Leader; Respectful Relationships Leader

label: Cultural Lead
description: Cultural safety, community connection and family partnership.
also_known_as: Koorie Engagement Support Officer; Multicultural Education Aide; Cultural Liaison

label: Daily Organiser
description: Relief staffing, cover and timetable changes on the day.

label: Support Coordinator
description: Coordinates ES staff on the day, triages DI and student needs and handles DI admin.
also_known_as: DI Coordinator; Integration Coordinator; ES Coordinator; Learning Support Coordinator; Inclusion Support Coordinator; Hub Coordinator; Student Support Coordinator

label: School Nurse
description: Health support plans, medication and health procedures.

label: First Aid Officer
description: Day-to-day first aid response and health records.
also_known_as: First Aid Coordinator; Sick Bay Officer

label: Allied Health Professional
description: Speech, OT, physio or psychology — internal or external.

label: Transition Coordinator
description: Transition in, between years, and to post-school pathways.
also_known_as: Pathways Leader; Careers Coordinator; Transition Leader
